# todos

A small todo module. See git history for the conversation.

stages.message: Build a small todo module, todos.py: a TodoList class — add(title) adds a todo, list() returns the todos in insertion order as (title, done) tuples, and mark_done(title) marks one done. Write tests for it.

requirements.text: todos.py with add(title), insertion-ordered list(), and mark_done(title)

hidden_tests.test_stage1_basic.py:
from todos import TodoList


def test_add_and_list_in_order():
    t = TodoList()
    t.add("write spec")
    t.add("write code")
    titles = [e[0] for e in t.list()]
    assert titles == ["write spec", "write code"]
    # every entry carries its done flag
    assert all(isinstance(e[1], bool) for e in t.list())


def test_mark_done():
    t = TodoList()
    t.add("write spec")
    t.mark_done("write spec")
    entry = [e for e in t.list() if e[0] == "write spec"][0]
    assert entry[1] is True

stages.message: Todos can now have an optional due date: add(title, due=None) where due is a date string, and list() entries carry it as a third element. Everything else stays the same.

requirements.text: optional due date on todos, carried by list() as a third element

hidden_tests.test_stage2_due.py:
from todos import TodoList


def test_due_optional_and_carried():
    t = TodoList()
    t.add("write spec", due="2027-01-15")
    t.add("write code")
    assert t.list() == [
        ("write spec", False, "2027-01-15"),
        ("write code", False, None),
    ]

stages.message: Last thing: a way to see only the unfinished todos. pending() should return the not-yet-done ones, still in insertion order, same entry shape as list().

requirements.text: pending() returns the not-done todos in insertion order

from todos import TodoList


def test_pending_filters_done():
    t = TodoList()
    t.add("a")
    t.add("b", due="2027-02-01")
    t.add("c")
    t.mark_done("a")
    assert t.pending() == [
        ("b", False, "2027-02-01"),
        ("c", False, None),
    ]
